summary: the same attribute name is declared twice inside one entity
rationale: A repeated attribute renders twice in the entity box, so the entity shows a field list the data does not have.

summary: an entity attribute block is defined more than once
help: Merge the blocks into one entity declaration.
rationale: Mermaid merges the blocks, so the second block is usually copy-paste noise that hides a real difference.

summary: an entity has a defined block but no relationship
help: Connect the entity to another entity, or remove it.
rationale: An entity with no relationship renders as an isolated box, which is sometimes intended, so this rule is off by default.
